closest_prior_art.citation: Boswell, P. G., Stoll, D. R., Carr, P. W., Nagel, M. L., Vitha, M. F., & Mabbott, G. A. (2013). An Advanced, Interactive, High-Performance Liquid Chromatography Simulator and Instructor Resources. Journal of Chemical Education, 90(2), 198–202.
closest_prior_art.overlap: Web-based interactive HPLC simulation, Van Deemter plate height, isocratic and gradient elution, column temperature, particle size, flow rate, baseline noise.
closest_prior_art.distinction: Boswell et al. calibrated 22 compounds experimentally on an Agilent Zorbax SB-C18 column. SimuPharm covers 7 different analytical instruments in a single unified web platform, includes fault injection modes, and links to automated system suitability testing (SST).

closest_prior_art.citation: Armenta, S., & Martínez-Pérez-Cejuela, H. (2026). Closing the Theory-Practice Gap in Analytical Chemistry: A Gas Chromatography Simulator for Enhanced Student Learning. Journal of Chemical Education, 103(8), 4643–4652.
closest_prior_art.overlap: Gas chromatography simulation, temperature programming, Golay equation, capillary column optimization.
closest_prior_art.distinction: Armenta is MATLAB-based; SimuPharm GC is browser-native (zero installation), provides visual chassis animation, and is integrated with pharmaceutical analysis curricula.

closest_prior_art.citation: Molnár, I., & Horváth, C. (1980) / Molnár Institute. DryLab Chromatography Modeling Software.
closest_prior_art.overlap: Linear Solvent Strength modeling, gradient retention prediction, resolution optimization.
closest_prior_art.distinction: DryLab is a high-cost commercial method-development suite ($10,000+) requiring 2-4 physical calibration runs. SimuPharm is an open, client-side educational simulation platform.

novelty_verdict: SimuPharm's novelty is NOT in deriving new chromatographic equations or inventing new AI algorithms. Its legitimate scientific novelty lies in the: (1) UNIFIED MULTI-INSTRUMENT IN SILICO ANALYTICAL SUITE (7 instruments under a single synchronized computational architecture), (2) BROWSER-BASED REAL-TIME NUMERICAL GRADIENT CHROMATOGRAPHY ENGINE with interactive parameter sensitivity, and (3) SYSTEMIC FAULT-INJECTION PEDAGOGICAL FRAMEWORK for analytical troubleshooting.
